names.name: Coffee with chicory
names.said: Half coffee, half hot milk, and the chicory is not optional.

text.what: Coffee blended with roasted chicory root and cut half-and-half with hot milk.
text.story: The French brought coffee to the Gulf Coast and the Mississippi around 1700. During the Civil War, with coffee short, New Orleans Creoles stretched it with chicory, which adds a chocolate-like note. The practice outlived the shortage.
text.today: Served at Café du Monde and across New Orleans, beside beignets, in a cup that leaves sugar on the rim.

kin.as: What the rest of the country pours instead.
